desc: The 10/22 Target Lite comes with a cold hammer-forged barrel, tensioned in an aluminum alloy barrel sleeve. The muzzle features a 1/2''-28 thread for attaching aftermarket suppressors (includes thread protector). The laminate hardwood stock features a flat rubber buttpad, a roll over cheek piece, an ambidextrous thumbhole pistol grip, and adjusts for length of pull. A BX-Trigger breaks crisply at 2.5–3 pounds, with minimum overtravel and a positive reset. The 10/22 utilizes a blowback, semi-auto action and a 10-shot rotary magazine, both of which are legendary for reliability.
